controller_decision_on_HIDE_KERNEL_TURN.finding: the audit reports both documented prerequisites now MET -- the approval round-trip and answer surfacing -- and correctly says do not flip the default as the fix.
controller_decision_on_HIDE_KERNEL_TURN.decision: HIDE_KERNEL_TURN stays FALSE, and this is now an explicit off-by-design declaration rather than a pending item, as Odyssey gate G4 permits.
controller_decision_on_HIDE_KERNEL_TURN.consequence_stated_as_G4_requires: The default turn is the single-shot run_turn_core path. Planner/Executor/Verifier, mid-turn tool loops and mid-turn approval are opt-in only, so the shipped default product does not plan, use tools or verify within a turn.
controller_decision_on_HIDE_KERNEL_TURN.why_not_promote_now: The prerequisites being met makes promotion possible, not correct. The substrate this would drive produced byte-identical prompt-independent output in its first measured generation (HAWKING_GRAVITY_SERVE_FIRST_GENERATION.json). Turning on a planning, tool-using, self-verifying loop over a model that may not be conditioning on its input would manufacture exactly the facade the archaeology exists to find. Revisit once GRAVITY_DEGENERATE_ATTRIBUTION settles H1 vs H2.
